label: nothing
what: No supported conclusion that two or more people were jointly preparing something kept from the mayor. Lanterns, bread commerce and vague bakery rumors do not establish a concealed event. There was coordination over a proposed two-bed installation at the inn (innkeeper and builder, with neighbour seeking the builder on freight's recommendation), but the mayor was told about that proposal and it awaited a complete quote and approval. Probability of a joint preparation unknown to the mayor: 0.12; no participants or knowing helpers in such a concealed preparation can reliably be identified.
